name: Koolking Industries India Limited
description: We manufacture and supply a comprehensive range of brass and copper HVAC components across four business verticals: IDU components, ODU components, other HVAC components (brass flare nuts and dead nuts), and refrigeration components. Our products find application in commercial and residential air conditioners as well as in the refrigeration industry.

objects.purpose: Funding the capital expenditure towards the Proposed Projects
Funding the capital expenditure towards purchase of new machinery and equipment at our existing Manufacturing Facilities
Funding the working capital requirements of our Company

top_risks: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from a limited number of key customers. Our top 10 customers contributed towards 89.71%, 89.36% and 88.38% of our revenue from operations during Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

We depend on a limited number of third parties for the supply of raw materials. Our top 10 suppliers contributed towards 79.33%, 71.38% and 70.70% of total purchases during Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
Our business is seasonal in nature and depends significantly on demand from the air conditioning and refrigeration industry.
